 For the Petitioner : Mr. Onkar Nath Tewary, Advocate
 For the State : Mr. Vijoy Kumar Sinha, A.P.P.
 For O.P. No.2 : Mr. Sudhansu Kumar Deo, Advocate
 -----
06/16.04.2024

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the Stat
and Mr. Sudhansu Kumar Deo, learned counsel for the informant.

2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Madhupur (Mahila) P.S. Case
No.15/2020, corresponding to G.R. Case No.262/2021, registered for the alleged offence under
Section 498A, 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, pending in the
Court of the learned S.D.J.M., Madhupur.

3. Vide order dated 11.01.2024, the petitioner was provided privilege of anticipatory bail
provisionally for three months.

4.  Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is the husband and in view of the order passed in the present A.B.A., the husband and wife, both are residing together and there is no difficulty.
He submits that the petitioner and opposite party no.2 are present in the Court.
5. Learned counsel for opposite party no.2 submits that the wife is residing along with the petitioner and children and they are living happy conjugal life in matrimonial house.

sentences.text:
Considering that the privilege of anticipatory bail was provided provisionally for three months and the petitioner has already furnished bail bond in terms of the order dated 11.01.2024 and in view of that, the provisional bail granted to the petitioner vide order dated 11.01.2024 is, hereby,
confirmed.
7. Since the petitioner has already furnished the bail bond, he will be allowed to remain on same bail bond.
8. Accordingly, this application is disposed of.

(Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Ajay/
